towns.name: Frost Haven
towns.summary: Frost Haven (68.4S 25.4E) is the Snowman village in the Linvak Mountain Range next to Mount Ingot (acpedia 'Frost Haven', added in Waking From the Abyss, updated in Cold Tracks): home of the Mayor, Chef Pleist, Elijah, Emma, Numb, Nip, Sam, David and Robert, the start of the Snowman Village and Blind Snowman quests, and the target of the seasonal Assault on Frost Haven. In the DAT it sits in a small snow bowl at z 290 (LB 0x9F29) with ice and snow ridges rising to 320-360 on every side and Mount Ingot's white flank climbing past 500 m to the north: five dark glass-roofed snow huts ring a central clearing, six glowing lanterns stand between them, snow-laden blue-lit trees, a bed of glowing blue flowers by Robert, blue ice crystals scattered on the slopes and a teal glowing stone; the valley opens to the west.
